liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ripple** (2 reviews): The soundboard Ripple starts abruptly, about a third of the way into the song; The harmonies on Ripple are beautiful [7][10]
- **To Lay Me Down** (1 review): An audience member's chatter about missing his bus is clearly audible as the song peaks, ruining it for this reviewer [7]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Jerry has vocal problems on this song [10]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Jerry sounds as if he might faint while singing it [12]
- The encore closes the night after a Johnny B. Goode finale [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd80-09-29 s1t01 Dire Wolf**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd80-09-29 s1t02 On The Road Again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd80-09-29 s1t03 Bird Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd80-09-29 s1t04 Cassidy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd80-09-29 s1t05 I've Been All Around This World**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd80-09-29 s1t06 Heaven Help The Fool**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd80-09-29 s1t07 To Lay Me Down**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **gd80-09-29 s1t08 Dark Hollow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-09-29.144655.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 33 songs; 207 min [1]
- **gd80-09-29.sbd.hinko.21926.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 30 songs; 203 min; rated 4/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: Sound levels vary slightly; Jerry's guitar is often fuzzy, but overall this beats other copies; Warfield soundboards match the quality of the Reckoning album; some defects, but most tracks are excellent [8][9]
- **gd1980-09-29.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.106783.flac16**: source not stated; 30 songs; 204 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is fine; the acoustic set has quite a lot of audience chatter; Clear audience recording with an intimate feel, judged the best of the available copies [17][18]
- **gd1980-09-29.nak700.ellner.koucky.89075.flac16**: source not stated; 31 songs; 195 min [5]

## Around the show

- Jerry had equipment trouble with his guitar as the first electric set began [7]
- A man with no change for the Muni is heard talking near a microphone, unaware of it [16]
- This acoustic set is weaker than others in the Warfield and Radio City runs [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-09-29.144655.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; (3) x Nakamichi 700 mics (left/right cardioids, omni center - handheld shoulder high)> Custom mixer by Jamie Poris >… [1]. Also: The Nakamichi 300 source by Joani Walker, Paul Scotton and Charlie Miller supplies the acoustic set songs and a Drums patch; A first-generation Nakamichi 700 source from Ron Ellner, Mike Marino and Bill Koucky is also used [1]
- **gd80-09-29.sbd.hinko.21926.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Soundboard chain: SBD to MC to C to DAT to CD to EAC to SHN, by Darryl Hinko; To Lay Me Down is patched using an audience source [3]
- **gd1980-09-29.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.106783.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 300/CP1 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell UDXL-II90) [4]
- **gd1980-09-29.nak700.ellner.koucky.89075.flac16**: taped by Ron Elner; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Nakamichi 700s > Sony TC D-5 > Master Cassette > Teac Reel > CD [5]. Also: Ron Elner recorded and archived it, but the master cassettes were stolen; B. Koucky extracted and seeded the CD in December 2007 [5]
